# ⚡ DarkniusX Optimizer

[![Build](https://github.com/Raffxzr/DarkniusXOptimizer/actions/workflows/build.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Raffxzr/DarkniusXOptimizer/actions/workflows/build.yml) [![Latest release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Raffxzr/DarkniusXOptimizer)](https://github.com/Raffxzr/DarkniusXOptimizer/releases/latest) **DarkniusX Optimizer** (formerly *RaffOptimizer*) is a comprehensive, low-overhead device maintenance and gaming performance suite for **Magisk, KernelSU, KernelSU-Next, and APatch**. It combines advanced gaming graphics scaling, thermal unthrottling, universal GMS deep sleep, storage fstrim, kernel virtual memory tuning, multi-mode RAM flushing with custom whitelisting, cache cleaning, multi-user APK freezing/debloating, and a sleek **AMOLED Dark Red Material You (M3) WebUI**. --- ## ✨ Key Features - **🎮 Pixel LOD Scaler (Grafik MC)**: - Dynamically forces the ANGLE OpenGL/Vulkan driver texture Level of Detail offset (+4) for massive GPU load reduction and sustained FPS in heavy 3D titles (Free Fire, Free Fire MAX, Mobile Legends, PUBG Mobile / BGMI, or any custom app package). - Supports targeted per-package overrides or global system-wide enforcement. - **🔥 Darknius Thermal Killer**: - Terminates restrictive vendor thermal throttling daemons (`mi_thermald`, `thermal-engine`, `thermald`) and unconstrains thermal zone governors to prevent thermal frequency drops during extended gaming sessions. - **⚡ Smart GMS Doze & Screen-Off Deep Sleep**: - Universal sysconfig XML patcher supporting **Android 10 up to Android 17+**, treating Google Play Services as a standard battery-optimized application. - Fixes the notorious 100% CPU lockup and battery drain caused by older GMS doze scripts upon device wake-up. - Event-driven screen-off deep sleep daemon (`darknius-doze`) that engages `cmd deviceidle force-idle deep` with an 8-second grace period and zero disk I/O. - **🧹 Universal Storage Fstrim**: - Trims dirty and discarded flash storage blocks across `/data`, `/cache`, and `/system` to maintain optimal NAND flash read/write speeds and reduce I/O wait times. - **⚙️ Kernel VM & ZRAM Tuner**: - Quick-switch Linux virtual memory presets: `gaming` (ZRAM swappiness 160, cache pressure 50), `balance` (swappiness 60, pressure 100), and `multitasking` (swappiness 120, pressure 80). - **🛡️ Custom RAM Flush Whitelist**: - Free up memory before gaming using 4 flushing profiles (`safe`, `aggressive`, `extreme`, `custom`). - Whitelist custom background apps (`/data/adb/darkniusx/config/whitelist.list`) such as music players, discord, or messengers to keep them running during deep memory purges. - **🧼 Auto & Manual Cache Cleaner**: - Clean app `cache` and `code_cache` directories on demand or automatically via background service with customizable size thresholds (500MB, 1GB, 2GB, 3GB) and cron intervals. - **❄️ Multi-User APK Freezer & Debloater**: - Freeze (`disable-user`) or debloat system and user apps across all profiles (`User 0`, `User 10` Work Profile / Dual Apps) with color-coded safety indicators (🟢 Safe, 🟡 Caution, 🔴 Critical). - **🎨 AMOLED Dark Red Material You WebUI**: - True pitch-black AMOLED UI (`#000000`) with high-contrast dark red accents (`#e53935`), dynamic auto-marquee text scrolling, and real-time execution consoles. - Operates via native root bridge (`window.ksu.exec`) in KernelSU/APatch/MMRL or via the built-in HTTP CGI server at `http://127.0.0.1:8899`. --- ## 💻 Terminal Commands (`su`) | Feature | Command | Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Main Menu** | `su -c darknius` (or `dx`) | Show interactive helper and status summary | | **Pixel LOD Scaler** | `su -c darknius-lod enable [pkg]` | Enable LOD offset +4 (Grafik MC) for specific pkg or `all` | | **Pixel LOD Revert** | `su -c darknius-lod disable` | Restore stock texture LOD settings | | **Thermal Killer** | `su -c darknius-thermal enable` | Terminate thermal throttling daemons | | **Thermal Restore** | `su -c darknius-thermal disable` | Restart stock vendor thermal daemons | | **Storage Fstrim** | `su -c darknius-fstrim` | Trim `/data`, `/cache`, and `/system` partitions | | **Kernel VM Tuner** | `su -c darknius-vm set ` | Apply kernel swappiness & VFS cache pressure | | **Deep Sleep Daemon** | `su -c darknius-doze ` | Manage screen-off smart deep sleep daemon | | **Flush RAM** | `su -c darknius-flush [mode]` | Modes: `safe`, `aggressive`, `extreme`, `custom` | | **Clean Cache** | `su -c cleaner` | Clean all application caches immediately | | **Freeze App** | `su -c darknius-freeze freeze --user all` | Freeze app for `all` users or specific user ID | | **Unfreeze App** | `su -c darknius-freeze unfreeze --user all` | Restore frozen app | | **Debloat App** | `su -c darknius-debloat remove --user all --systemless` | Debloat app with systemless `.replace` masking | | **Restore App** | `su -c darknius-debloat restore --user all` | Restore removed debloated system app | | **Open WebUI** | `su -c darknius-webui open` | Start and launch the WebUI in your default browser | *Note: Backward-compatible command aliases (`raff`, `raff-flush`, `raff-freeze`, `raff-debloat`, `raff-webui`) remain available.* --- ## 📦 Installation 1. Download `DarkniusXOptimizer-v1.5.zip` from **Releases**. 2. Flash the zip via **Magisk**, **KernelSU**, or **APatch** Manager. - *Automatic Data Migration*: Upgrading from older `RaffOptimizer` versions automatically migrates your configs and debloat lists. 3. Reboot your device. 4. Launch the **WebUI** via your Root Manager (Action button) or execute `su -c darknius-webui open`. --- ## 🛠️ Building from Source Requirements: `bash`, `zip`, and `unzip`. ```bash git clone https://github.com/Raffxzr/DarkniusXOptimizer.git cd DarkniusXOptimizer ./build.sh ``` The flashable module zip is output to `dist/DarkniusXOptimizer-.zip`. ### Repository Structure ```text DarkniusXOptimizer/ ├── build.sh # Single entry point packaging pipeline ├── module.prop # Module metadata (id=DarkniusXOptimizer) ├── DarkniusX Module.png # Banner for README and root manager ├── update.json # Auto-update manifest for Magisk/KernelSU ├── customize.sh # Installer & universal GMS sysconfig patcher ├── service.sh / action.sh # Boot services and action button hooks ├── scripts/ # Sources for darknius CLI binaries ├── cleaner/ # Cache cleaner service & inotify daemon ├── webroot/ # AMOLED Dark Red Material You WebUI ├── system/priv-app/ # Bundled ShowToast.apk notification helper ├── system/xbin/ # 32-bit flush binaries ├── META-INF/ # Flashable zip installer metadata └── .github/workflows/ # CI build & automated release pipelines ``` --- ## 👤 Credits & License - **Developer**: [Raffxzr](https://github.com/Raffxzr) - **Flush RAM Reborn**: [@WeAreRavenS](https://t.me/WeAreRavenS) - **Cache Cleaner**: [taamarin/cleaner](https://github.com/taamarin/cleaner) - **Thermal Killer**: Based on [Licking-Thermal](https://github.com/fuckyoustan/Licking-Thermal/releases) by [@fuckyoustan](https://github.com/fuckyoustan) - **GMS Doze**: Based on [Extreme GMS Doze](https://github.com/Skyghost090/Extreme-Gms-Doze) by [@Skyghost090](https://github.com/Skyghost090) and [Universal GMS Doze](https://github.com/gloeyisk/universal-gms-doze) by [@gloeyisk](https://github.com/gloeyisk)

⚡ DarkniusX Optimizer

![Build](https://github.com/Raffxzr/DarkniusXOptimizer/actions/workflows/build.yml)

![Latest release](https://github.com/Raffxzr/DarkniusXOptimizer/releases/latest)

DarkniusX Optimizer (formerly *RaffOptimizer*) is a comprehensive, low-overhead device maintenance and gaming performance suite for Magisk, KernelSU, KernelSU-Next, and APatch.

It combines advanced gaming graphics scaling, thermal unthrottling, universal GMS deep sleep, storage fstrim, kernel virtual memory tuning, multi-mode RAM flushing with custom whitelisting, cache cleaning, multi-user APK freezing/debloating, and a sleek AMOLED Dark Red Material You (M3) WebUI.

---

✨ Key Features

  • **🎮 Pixel LOD Scaler (Grafik MC)**:

    • - Dynamically forces the ANGLE OpenGL/Vulkan driver texture Level of Detail offset (+4) for massive GPU load reduction and sustained FPS in heavy 3D titles (Free Fire, Free Fire MAX, Mobile Legends, PUBG Mobile / BGMI, or any custom app package).

    - Supports targeted per-package overrides or global system-wide enforcement.

  • **🔥 Darknius Thermal Killer**:

    • - Terminates restrictive vendor thermal throttling daemons (mi_thermald, thermal-engine, thermald) and unconstrains thermal zone governors to prevent thermal frequency drops during extended gaming sessions.

  • **⚡ Smart GMS Doze & Screen-Off Deep Sleep**:

    • - Universal sysconfig XML patcher supporting Android 10 up to Android 17+, treating Google Play Services as a standard battery-optimized application.

    - Fixes the notorious 100% CPU lockup and battery drain caused by older GMS doze scripts upon device wake-up.

    - Event-driven screen-off deep sleep daemon (darknius-doze) that engages cmd deviceidle force-idle deep with an 8-second grace period and zero disk I/O.

  • **🧹 Universal Storage Fstrim**:

    • - Trims dirty and discarded flash storage blocks across /data, /cache, and /system to maintain optimal NAND flash read/write speeds and reduce I/O wait times.

  • **⚙️ Kernel VM & ZRAM Tuner**:

    • - Quick-switch Linux virtual memory presets: gaming (ZRAM swappiness 160, cache pressure 50), balance (swappiness 60, pressure 100), and multitasking (swappiness 120, pressure 80).

  • **🛡️ Custom RAM Flush Whitelist**:

    • - Free up memory before gaming using 4 flushing profiles (safe, aggressive, extreme, custom).

    - Whitelist custom background apps (/data/adb/darkniusx/config/whitelist.list) such as music players, discord, or messengers to keep them running during deep memory purges.

  • **🧼 Auto & Manual Cache Cleaner**:

    • - Clean app cache and code_cache directories on demand or automatically via background service with customizable size thresholds (500MB, 1GB, 2GB, 3GB) and cron intervals.

  • **❄️ Multi-User APK Freezer & Debloater**:

    • - Freeze (disable-user) or debloat system and user apps across all profiles (User 0, User 10 Work Profile / Dual Apps) with color-coded safety indicators (🟢 Safe, 🟡 Caution, 🔴 Critical).

  • **🎨 AMOLED Dark Red Material You WebUI**:

    • - True pitch-black AMOLED UI (#000000) with high-contrast dark red accents (#e53935), dynamic auto-marquee text scrolling, and real-time execution consoles.

    - Operates via native root bridge (window.ksu.exec) in KernelSU/APatch/MMRL or via the built-in HTTP CGI server at http://127.0.0.1:8899.

    ---

    💻 Terminal Commands (`su`)

    | Feature | Command | Description |

    | :--- | :--- | :--- |

    | Main Menu | su -c darknius (or dx) | Show interactive helper and status summary |

    | Pixel LOD Scaler | su -c darknius-lod enable [pkg] | Enable LOD offset +4 (Grafik MC) for specific pkg or all |

    | Pixel LOD Revert | su -c darknius-lod disable | Restore stock texture LOD settings |

    | Thermal Killer | su -c darknius-thermal enable | Terminate thermal throttling daemons |

    | Thermal Restore | su -c darknius-thermal disable | Restart stock vendor thermal daemons |

    | Storage Fstrim | su -c darknius-fstrim | Trim /data, /cache, and /system partitions |

    | Kernel VM Tuner | su -c darknius-vm set | Apply kernel swappiness & VFS cache pressure |

    | Deep Sleep Daemon | su -c darknius-doze | Manage screen-off smart deep sleep daemon |

    | Flush RAM | su -c darknius-flush [mode] | Modes: safe, aggressive, extreme, custom |

    | Clean Cache | su -c cleaner | Clean all application caches immediately |

    | Freeze App | su -c darknius-freeze freeze --user all | Freeze app for all users or specific user ID |

    | Unfreeze App | su -c darknius-freeze unfreeze --user all | Restore frozen app |

    | Debloat App | su -c darknius-debloat remove --user all --systemless | Debloat app with systemless .replace masking |

    | Restore App | su -c darknius-debloat restore --user all | Restore removed debloated system app |

    | Open WebUI | su -c darknius-webui open | Start and launch the WebUI in your default browser |

    *Note: Backward-compatible command aliases (raff, raff-flush, raff-freeze, raff-debloat, raff-webui) remain available.*

    ---

    📦 Installation

  • Download `DarkniusXOptimizer-v1.5.zip` from **Releases**.
  • Flash the zip via **Magisk**, **KernelSU**, or **APatch** Manager.

    • - *Automatic Data Migration*: Upgrading from older RaffOptimizer versions automatically migrates your configs and debloat lists.

  • Reboot your device.
  • Launch the **WebUI** via your Root Manager (Action button) or execute `su -c darknius-webui open`.

    • ---

    🛠️ Building from Source

    Requirements: bash, zip, and unzip.

    git clone https://github.com/Raffxzr/DarkniusXOptimizer.git
cd DarkniusXOptimizer
./build.sh

    The flashable module zip is output to dist/DarkniusXOptimizer-.zip.

    Repository Structure

    DarkniusXOptimizer/
├── build.sh                  # Single entry point packaging pipeline
├── module.prop               # Module metadata (id=DarkniusXOptimizer)
├── DarkniusX Module.png      # Banner for README and root manager
├── update.json               # Auto-update manifest for Magisk/KernelSU
├── customize.sh              # Installer & universal GMS sysconfig patcher
├── service.sh / action.sh    # Boot services and action button hooks
├── scripts/                  # Sources for darknius CLI binaries
├── cleaner/                  # Cache cleaner service & inotify daemon
├── webroot/                  # AMOLED Dark Red Material You WebUI
├── system/priv-app/          # Bundled ShowToast.apk notification helper
├── system/xbin/              # 32-bit flush binaries
├── META-INF/                 # Flashable zip installer metadata
└── .github/workflows/        # CI build & automated release pipelines

    ---
